data.name: Kishor
data.gender_notes: Kishor is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit kiśora, 'a youth, a colt'. Its root is Sanskrit kiśora (किशोर). A classical Sanskrit term for youth. Kishor is a Sanskrit name meaning “Young; a youth; a colt”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kishor expresses “Young; a youth; a colt”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit kiśora, 'a youth, a colt'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kishor total 35, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
